record.title: AnchorCoT: Anchors Pave the Way for Multi-hop Reasoning
record.scope_reason: AnchorCoT predicts anchor entities and ranks reasoning paths for general multihop QA. Both full abstracts explicitly evaluate HotpotQA,2WikiMultiHopQA and MuSiQue-Ans; no biomedical primary task is present.

record.title: Token Pruning in Multimodal Large Language Models: Are We Solving the Right Problem?
record.scope_reason: The paper analyzes generic multimodal token pruning. Physical page4 compares GQA,MMBench,MME,POPE,ScienceQA,TextVQA and VizWiz; the objective is inference efficiency and pruning design, not medical imaging. VizWiz accessibility relevance is not a clinical task.

record.title: Federated Data-Efficient Instruction Tuning for Large Language Models
record.scope_reason: FedHDS studies data-efficient federated instruction tuning. Section5.1 physical page6 uses Natural Instructions and Dolly-15K, simulated task/Dirichlet clients and Rouge-L on unseen tasks. Private client data is a generic motivation, not a patient-data experiment.

record.title: They want to pretend not to understand: The Limits of Current LLMs in Interpreting Implicit Content of Political Discourse
record.scope_reason: The study evaluates implicatures and presuppositions in Italian political speeches from IMPAQTS. It is political pragmatics and model interpretation, not medical or biomedical language.

record.title: ZeroNER: Fueling Zero-Shot Named Entity Recognition via Entity Type Descriptions
record.scope_reason: ZeroNER is a generic zero-shot NER framework. Section4 physical page6 specifies three heterogeneous domains: biomedical MedMentions, general OntoNotes and legal LegalNER. MedMentions/UMLS is one mixed-domain evaluation, not the primary subject, so the paper is excluded despite substantial biomedical benchmark use.

record.title: Do Large Language Models Have “Emotion Neurons”? Investigating the Existence and Role
record.scope_reason: Emotion neurons refers to artificial FFN units in LLMs. Section3 physical page3 measures activation under six emotion labels in dialogue and masks model units; it does not study biological neurons, clinical symptoms or mental-health outcomes. The research is model interpretability.

record.title: Grammar-Based Code Representation: Is It a Worthy Pursuit for LLMs?
record.scope_reason: GrammarCoder studies grammar-based programming representations, evaluated on HumanEval/MBPP and their enhanced variants. The task is software code generation and semantic correctness, not biomedical computation.

record.title: Investigating Inference-time Scaling for Chain of Multi-modal Thought: A Preliminary Study
record.scope_reason: The work scales multimodal reasoning at inference time. Section3.1 physical page4 lists geometry(Geometry3K,graph connectivity/maxflow/isomorphism), mathematics(parity/convexity/winnerID) and general VQA(V*Bench,MMVP,BLINK). None is a biomedical-primary task.

record.title: UI-E2I-Synth: Advancing GUI Grounding with Large-Scale Instruction Synthesis
record.scope_reason: UI-E2I-Synth generates GUI instruction-grounding data and introduces UI-I2E-Bench. The subject is mapping screen instructions to interface elements, not a healthcare interface or clinical task.

record.title: A Study into Investigating Temporal Robustness of LLMs
record.scope_reason: The paper evaluates temporal robustness of general factual QA. Section3 and Table1 physical page3 use Wikidata, historical NewYorkTimes/ArchivalQA, Wikipedia world events and temporal fact-check claims. It is temporal world knowledge, not clinical chronology.

record.title: ToolExpNet: Optimizing Multi-Tool Selection in LLMs with Similarity and Dependency-Aware Experience Networks
record.scope_reason: ToolExpNet improves generic multi-tool selection. Section4.1 physical page4 uses RestBench TMDB movie APIs,Spotify music APIs,and broad ToolBench RapidAPI/BMTools. There is no primary biomedical tool workflow.

record.title: SPILL: Domain-Adaptive Intent Clustering based on Selection and Pooling with Large Language Models
record.scope_reason: SPILL is generic domain-adaptive intent clustering. Table2 and evaluation on physical page6 cover SGD,Bank77,Clinc150,Mtop and Massive utterances. Clinc150 is an intent dataset name, not a clinical corpus; no biomedical primary experiment is established.

record.title: How Far are LLMs from Being Our Digital Twins? A Benchmark for Persona-Based Behavior Chain Simulation
record.scope_reason: BehaviorChain simulates literary-character behavior rather than medical digital twins. Section3 physical pages3–4 derives personas and behavior chains from novels/biographies,SuperSummary,ProjectGutenberg and e-books, with a GreatGatsby example. Healthcare appears only in related-work motivation; the actual benchmark is generic narrative behavior.

record.title: GRI-QA: a Comprehensive Benchmark for Table Question Answering over Environmental Data
record.scope_reason: GRI-QA evaluates table QA over corporate environmental-sustainability reports and GRI standards. It is corporate environmental data extraction/reasoning, not medical or biomedical research.

record.title: WebUIBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating Multimodal Large Language Models in WebUI-to-Code
record.scope_reason: WebUIBench evaluates webpage perception,HTML programming,WebUI-HTML understanding and WebUI-to-code over real websites. This is software-engineering evaluation, not a medical task.

record.title: Optimizing Multi-Hop Document Retrieval Through Intermediate Representations
record.scope_reason: L-RAG retrieves next-hop evidence using intermediate representations. Both abstracts explicitly evaluate open-domain MuSiQue,HotpotQA and2WikiMultiHopQA; the main task is general QA efficiency,not biomedical retrieval.

record.title: Towards Better Understanding of Program-of-Thought Reasoning in Cross-Lingual and Multilingual Environments
record.scope_reason: The paper studies multilingual program-of-thought reasoning. Physical page4 defines multilingual GSM8K program variants and code-quality/answer-accuracy analysis. The research concerns mathematics,program generation and language alignment,not biomedical reasoning.

record.title: A Fully Automated Pipeline for Conversational Discourse Annotation: Tree Scheme Generation and Labeling with Large Language Models
record.scope_reason: The automatic discourse-annotation pipeline learns decision trees for speech-function/dialogue-act labeling. Physical page4 evaluates SpeechFunctions and Switchboard telephone conversations. It is general conversation annotation,not clinical discourse assessment.

record.title: Can Language Models Serve as Analogy Annotators?
record.scope_reason: A3E uses cognitive-psychology-inspired structure mapping to annotate story analogies. Sections4 and limitations on physical pages4–5 evaluate the StoryAnalogy dataset with narrative-pair labels and general LLMs. It is analogy annotation and model reasoning,not clinical psychology or biomedical assessment.

record.title: Reward Generalization in RLHF: A Topological Perspective
record.scope_reason: The RLHF topology paper studies reward generalization. Physical page8 uses HH-RLHF conversation,DialogueSum summarization and GSM8K mathematics, with PPO/RFT comparisons. No biomedical primary task is present.

record.title: Generalizable Cross-Lingual Cognitive Distortion Detection with Standardized Annotations and Multi-Task Learning
record.reason: Primary mental-health NLP research on cognitive distortion recognition grounded in Burns’ psychological theory. Physical pages 2–4 and 9 establish cross-language/cross-dataset detection on Chinese social-media and English reframing/therapist datasets, psychology-trained annotation and a 5702-sample harmonized dataset. The authors explicitly state research use rather than clinical diagnosis and acknowledge privacy, re-identification and cultural-generalization risks. This is a targeted mental-health research objective, not a generic model with incidental medical evaluation.
